paths.name: @civfix/ui
paths.message: The host console is plain DOM and may import ONLY @civfix/ui/data, @civfix/ui/i18n and (type-only) @civfix/ui/capabilities. Every other subpath reaches React Native.

paths.name: @civfix/ui/theme
paths.message: @civfix/ui/theme's barrel imports react-native. Use @civfix/ui/theme/schemes (the RN-free subpath) for scheme names and palettes, and components/console/use-color-scheme.ts to read the same `.dark` class the --console-* variables key off.

paths.name: @civfix/ui/realtime
paths.message: The realtime channel is mounted once by components/providers.tsx.

paths.name: @civfix/ui/typography
paths.message: Console typography comes from the Tailwind token scale.

paths.name: @civfix/ui/capabilities
paths.message: Capabilities are React-Native-shaped. Type-only imports are allowed; use @/lib/web-camera for the console's own camera seam.

paths.name: next/navigation
paths.message: The console is one static shell served by the SPA fallback: navigate with components/console/url-state.ts, never a Next route transition.

paths.name: next/link
paths.message: Use layout/console-link.tsx: a Next transition would target a path the static manifest does not contain.

paths.name: next/router
paths.message: The console is App Router + its own history bridge.

patterns.message: The host console is plain DOM: no React Native, ever.

The host console is plain DOM and may import ONLY @civfix/ui/data, @civfix/ui/i18n, @civfix/ui/theme/schemes and (type-only) @civfix/ui/capabilities. Every other subpath reaches React Native. Nested subpaths (e.g. surface/liquidGlass) are React-Native and Skia.
